name: telemetry_sdk
_comment_version_1_1_0: 1.0.1 -> 1.1.0: telemetry_sdk now really owns delivery: TelemetrySdkDependencies.register calls TelemetryBootstrap.enableSpool, which installs TelemetrySpool.deliver as the TelemetryClient transport. Online events still go out as the same platform-gateway POST (cmd + payload, through base_sdk HttpService); offline events, or ones whose send fails at the network level, are queued on the device (base_sdk LocalStorage JSON record telemetry_spool, capped at 500, oldest dropped) instead of lost, and flushed in batches of 20 when connectivity returns (connectivity_plus, AppConnectivity.isOnline), at boot, and after any successful live send. Rejections are still rethrown so the client keeps its control: fallback. New deps connectivity_plus/dio at base_sdk's constraints; install.py unchanged, so composer sha256 pins stay valid.
_comment: Delivery-policy owner for the telemetry lane (ADR-005/ADR-006). base_sdk owns TelemetryClient (the one client every SDK may import); this SDK owns WHEN/HOW events leave the device by injecting through TelemetryClient.configure's TelemetryTransport seam. No pages, no routes, no HTTP of its own: the composed shell's generated sdk-di block calls TelemetrySdkDependencies.register, which applies telemetry_sdk's delivery policy at boot: TelemetrySpool (send online through the base_sdk gateway POST, queue offline, flush in batches when connectivity returns). The frappe half (core/telemetry) is the backend: api_error_log + log_frontend_error/track_event whitelisted methods.
